entries.1a7092b2a744ea3b: The company manufactures and sells seat mechanisms, electrical components and electronic products, and group companies handle wire harnesses for aircraft and machine tools, welfare equipment such as electric wheelchairs, prosthetic arms and prosthetic legs, and image and video processing devices.
entries.4de5b73ff590ff07: An automotive parts manufacturer that makes and sells mechanism parts for automobile seats and electrical and electronic products, and also handles wire harnesses and welfare equipment.
entries.6ea9c09dceff0916: The group consists of the company, 14 subsidiaries and 2 affiliates; its main businesses are the manufacture and sale of seat mechanisms, electrical components and electronic products for automobiles, and it also manufactures and sells wire harnesses and welfare equipment. There are 3 reportable segments: Japan, North America and Asia; consolidated sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥87,149 million.
entries.73ac8f29a48b8ea9: Subsidiaries in the United States and Mexico manufacture and sell seat mechanism products, and the Mexican subsidiary also sells electronic products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥25,004 million.

entries.9ce8ffc6b34ae16d: Subsidiaries in China, Thailand, the Philippines, India, Indonesia and Taiwan manufacture and sell seat mechanism products, electrical components and electronic products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,683 million.
